title: 「Meanwhile」表示同時發生的事情

source.file: Sentence Structure 197 -「Meanwhile」表示同時發生的事情.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: Complete sentence A. Meanwhile, complete sentence B.

formulas.formula: Complete sentence A. Meanwhile, complete sentence B.

example: I’m preparing dinner. Meanwhile, my brother is setting the table.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：Complete sentence A. Meanwhile, complete sentence B.。

rules.zh: Meanwhile 前後通常都是完整句子 本練習使用以下標準格式： Meanwhile 前面使用句號，而 Meanwhile 後面使用逗號。
rules.en: Meanwhile normally links two complete sentences. This exercise uses the standard punctuation: Sentence A. Meanwhile, sentence B. Put a full stop before Meanwhile and a comma after it.

rules.zh: 兩件事情不必在完全相同的一秒發生 Meanwhile 可以表示： ● 兩個動作正在同時進行； ● 兩項工作在同一段期間內進行； ● 等待某件事情完成期間，另一件事情正在發生。 （圖書館正在翻新。與此同時，讀者可以使用隔壁的自修室。）
rules.en: The two events need not happen at exactly the same second. Meanwhile can show two actions in progress at once, two tasks taking place within the same period, or another event occurring while people wait for something to finish. Example: The library is being renovated. Meanwhile, readers can use the study room next door.
examples: The library is being renovated. Meanwhile, readers can use the study room next door.

rules.zh: Meanwhile 不是表示先後次序 如第二件事情在第一件事情完成後才發生，應使用 then、afterwards 或 later，而不是
rules.en: Meanwhile does not show that one event happens after another. If the second event begins only after the first has finished, use then, afterwards, or later instead of meanwhile.

rules.zh: Meanwhile 和 while 的句子結構不同 While 是連接詞，可以把兩個部分連成一句： Meanwhile 通常另開一個完整句子：
rules.en: Meanwhile and while use different sentence structures. While is a conjunction that can join two parts in one sentence: While Mia was studying, her brother was watching television. Meanwhile normally opens a separate complete sentence: Mia was studying. Meanwhile, her brother was watching television.
examples: While Mia was studying, her brother was watching television.
Mia was studying. Meanwhile, her brother was watching television.

rules.zh: 保留原句的時態和語意 改寫時，只改變連接方式。人物、動作、時間、肯定或否定意思都不應改變。
rules.en: Preserve the original tense and meaning; change only how the events are connected.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能讓讀者立即明白，兩件事情正在同時或同一段期間內發生。
benefits.en: It clearly shows that two things are happening during the same period The reader can immediately understand that the two events are taking place at the same time or within the same period.

benefits.zh: 當兩個部分都包含較多資料時，你可以把它們分成兩個完整句子，使內容更容易理解。 第二個版本把兩項工作分開說明，讓讀者更容易掌握每個團隊正在做甚麼。
benefits.en: It makes detailed information easier to follow Instead of placing two long ideas inside one sentence with while, you can separate them into two complete sentences. Compare: While the marketing team is planning the campaign, the design team is creating promotional materials. The marketing team is planning the campaign. Meanwhile, the design team is creating promotional materials.

benefits.zh: 你可以把讀者的注意力由一個人物、團隊或地點轉移到另一個，同時保持兩件事情之間的時間關 係。
benefits.en: It helps organise stories, reports and updates You can move the reader’s attention from one person, group or place to another without losing the connection between the events.

benefits.zh: Meanwhile 亦可以突出兩種不同甚至相反的情況正在同時發展。
benefits.en: It can highlight a contrast between two developments Meanwhile can show that two different or even opposite situations are developing at the same time.

benefits.zh: 適當使用 Meanwhile，可以避免反覆使用 while 或 at the same time，令作文、報告、簡報和工作 匯報的句式更有變化。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to repeatedly using while or at the same time Using Meanwhile appropriately creates more sentence variety in stories, essays, reports, presentations and workplace updates.
